value_callee: the function called is a value in this code, and Carrick found no function behind it
outside_service: it is declared in a file outside the services Carrick reads
package_unmatched: it calls a package that has network calls, and this call matches none of them
unanswered_package: Carrick has no answer yet for the package this calls
no_body: the function it reaches has no body Carrick read
interface_member: it calls a member of an interface, and no implementation was found
several_values: the function called is a value that can be several different functions, and they do not agree on where it goes
values_over_cap: the function called can be more functions than Carrick follows
value_never_bound: nothing in this code gives the function called a value
injected_callee: the function is passed in from elsewhere, and nothing says which
several_implementations: it could go to more than one place, depending on which version of the code runs
implementations_over_cap: too many possible targets to follow
missed_inside: it passes through a call Carrick did not read
unplaced: Carrick found the call but could not place it in the file
name_never_bound: the name is only known when the program runs
callback_parameter: the name is a parameter of a callback this code does not call, so only the running program knows it
several_operations: different branches reach this call with different operations, so which one runs depends on its arguments
no_op_claim: it calls a networking library whose call shape Carrick doesn't know yet, so where it goes isn't stated
below_band: Carrick wasn't sure enough to state it
unanswered: this call couldn't be checked on this scan
no_method: a route looks registered here, but no request method is stated (often a sub-app mounted under a prefix)
owner_unknown: a route looks registered here, but Carrick can't tell which router it hangs from, so its full path is unknown
uncorroborated: only the library's label points at this target; the code doesn't state it and no other reading agrees
mount_unverified: the router is handed to a call that Carrick could not verify mounts it, so the full path is unknown
entry_point: the function holding it is called by nothing in this code and handed to no library
runs_by_library: a library runs the function holding it, and no known scope applies
callback_option: the function holding it sits under a key of an options object, and what reads that key is not read
unread: it is a value Carrick does not read (a field, a call's result, a conditional)
reassigned: the name is assigned more than once, so it has no single value
unread_expression: it is written in a form Carrick does not read (a computed key, a call result, a spread, an await)
in_repo_value_import: the value is imported from another module of this service, and Carrick did not read it there
unresolved_import: the name comes from an import Carrick couldn't read
callback_into_own_function: the function is handed to another function in this code, and what that does with it is not read
callee_unread: the function is handed to a call whose callee Carrick could not read
own_function: the call goes to a function in this code, and what that does with the name is not read
no_caller_not_exported: the function holding it is called by nothing and exported by nothing
detached_unplaced: the function is held in a variable or returned, so nothing says where it is called
caller_arg_missing: the caller passes nothing Carrick reads in that position
fan_out_cap: there are more callers than Carrick follows
recursion: the calls loop back to a function already passed
rows_missing: the compiler engine has no reading of this position
rows_stale: the file changed since the compiler engine read it
not_in_program: the compiler engine did not read this file
checker_threw: the type checker failed at this position
unresolved_name: the compiler engine could not find what this name refers to
untyped_receiver: Carrick can't tell what kind of object this is
several_paths: the value reads as more than one path, so it has no single path
procedure_router_outside_repo: the procedure's router is declared outside this repository's source, so Carrick can't name it
procedure_router_ambiguous: the procedure's first key is declared in more than one place, so Carrick can't name its router
procedure_path_unread: part of the procedure's key path is not written as a name Carrick can read
parameter_unread: the value comes from a parameter this function's callers fill, and this reader does not read through callers
env_value: the name is read from the environment when the program runs
